newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek bonds firmer, ecu/drs ranges, forwards up.
newsitem.headline: Greek bonds firmer, ecu/drs ranges, forwards up.

text.p: Greek bonds were firmer, ecu/drachma was trading in narrow ranges dipping below the 304 level and forex forwards were up across-the-board in late quiet trade, dealers said.
Bond dealers said there was interest from abroad for both taxable and non-taxable FRNs and coupon bonds betting that pending tax issues would be shortly resolved.
"There is a yield spread between taxable and non-taxable securities and some players position themselves discounting a solution on pending taxation issues," dealers said.
Dealers reported a pick up in three-year coupon bonds auctioned in late January.
Forex forwards were up 10 to 15 pips across-the-maturity spectrum with the upward bias more accentuated in one-year tenors in a correction, dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 156.27/37 drachmas from Thursday's 156.140 fix, the dollar at 263.16/26 drachmas from 262.700 and the Ecu at 303.95/05 from 303.970 drachmas.
"The drachma has firmed against the ecu trading below 304 in late dealings," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
